name: STGT fold 1 drowsiness model
feature_extractor: ML Kit Face Mesh 468 (MediaPipe canonical indices)
notes: Android extracts EAR from [362,385,387,263,373,380] and [33,160,158,133,153,144], and MAR from [78,308,13,14], matching the training pipeline. It persists a 1500-valid-frame per-driver baseline, applies Savitzky-Golay smoothing, normalization and six temporal deltas before sending a 75x12 sequence to TFLite. Head pose uses ML Kit Euler angles. ML Kit exposes 0..467 points but not refined iris 468..477, therefore Iris is neutralized instead of replaced with a noisy proxy.
